Buying · sales tax · certificates

Tax-exempt purchasing. For churches and resellers.

Listed prices on i9Store USA include neither sales tax nor shipping. Sales tax is added at checkout from the delivery address, except for customers with a sales tax exemption, such as resellers and religious institutions, who attach their certificate.

01 · Which certificate

Send the one that matches your organization.

i9Store USA sells from Florida, so Florida’s forms are the usual ones. Not sure which you have? Send it anyway; the team checks it.

Resellers and integrators

Florida Annual Resale Certificate

Form DR-13, for buying equipment you resell.

Churches and nonprofits

Consumer’s Certificate of Exemption

Form DR-14, issued to religious and nonprofit organizations; valid five years and verifiable online with the Florida Department of Revenue.

Government and other states

Send what you have

Government buyers and certificates from other states: the team tells you whether it applies to your order.

Tax-exempt questions.

Who qualifies, the rate, certificates and returns.

Who can buy without sales tax?

Customers with a sales tax exemption, such as resellers and religious institutions, with a valid certificate. Everyone else pays sales tax on top of the listed price, worked out from the delivery address at checkout.

What is the sales tax on a Miami pickup?

Florida’s 6% plus Miami-Dade’s 1% surtax, so 7% in most cases. The 1% surtax applies only to the first $5,000 of each item, so a single item above $5,000 pays a little less than 7% overall.

Which certificate do I send?

Resellers: a Florida Annual Resale Certificate. Churches and other religious or nonprofit organizations: a Florida Consumer’s Certificate of Exemption. Government buyers and certificates from other states: send what you have and the team tells you whether it applies.

When is the exemption applied?

Attach the certificate at checkout, or send it with a quote. The order shows “Exempt, pending certificate review”, and a specialist confirms the exemption before the order ships.

What is the return policy?

Returns are accepted for 30 days from delivery or pickup. Items bought from November 1 through January 1 can be returned through February 1. An item that cannot be resold as new carries a restocking fee of at least 15%.
